target: AArch64 native ZealC under UTM-bundled QEMU/HVF, one vCPU, virtio-ramfb, VirtIO keyboard and tablet
command: QEMU=build/utm-qemu-probe/qemu-probe QEMU_VIRT='-L /Applications/UTM.app/Contents/Resources/qemu -machine virt,accel=hvf,gic-version=3 -cpu host -smp 1 -m 1024 -device virtio-ramfb -device virtio-keyboard-device -device virtio-tablet-device' ZEAL_COMPAT_LOG_PATH=build/check-xcaliber-current-55719.log python3 -u scripts/check-compat.py --pci --quick --probe-xcaliber
checks: X-Caliber's startup popup appeared and its suppression checkbox worked.
Plain Left and Right thruster inputs changed the player ship; Space produced visible projectile-region changes.
Escape returned to the graphical terminal, which accepted and executed a shell command.
scope_note: Automated UTM-bundled QEMU evidence for the current exact ISO. Broader gameplay and live UTM/Pi app behavior are not covered.
